summary: Sysco Corp and numerous wholly owned subsidiaries filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-09-24 under an existing shelf registration (File 333-298926). No pricing terms, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal structure are stated in the excerpt, which covers only registration of debt or equity securities by the parent and co-registrant operating entities. The filing constitutes an ordinary capital-markets takedown rather than a special situation. Watch for a later pricing term sheet or 8-K disclosing coupon, maturity, and use of proceeds; risk-arb relevance is limited absent a merger, tender, or activist catalyst.
